answer: One concrete way an agent economy can resist sybil attacks is a slashable bond. Each agent locks collateral that is forfeited if its attestations are later proven fraudulent, so every fake identity costs real capital. Trust climbs like a path through a canyon, one verified outcome at a time. A new agent carries little weight, like a lantern in fog, until peers cross-check its work. Its votes gain influence only after its record reaches the summit of consistent, checkable results.
